verdict.rationale: The evidence documents RBAC that goes somewhat beyond basic roles: custom roles with assigned permissions, organization-scoped roles, IdP role assignment via SSO and Directory Sync, and enforcement through session JWTs. That is still role-based and scoped to the tenant, not to individual resources. The vague mention of "enforce access policies at scale" does not show a policy language or relationship model. missing for 10: resource-level (per-object) authorization, a relationship-based (ReBAC/Zanzibar-style) model, a policy-based (ABAC/policy language) engine, a permission-check API for individual resources, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
